title: Reported Speech: Adverbs and Demonstratives — Quiz 129A
content:
## Reported Speech: Adverbs and Demonstratives

Learn how this, that, these, those and time expressions change in reported speech.

### Lesson focus

1. He said, “I have bought this mobile for my mother.”
2. He said that he had bought the mobile for his mother.
3. He said, “I'll do the shopping this week.”
4. He said that he would do the shopping that week.

### Understand the pattern

Demonstratives do not always need a word-for-word replacement. If the object is already identified, the mobile can be clearer than that mobile. Time expressions must still match the day or week of the original message.

### Worked answers and explanation

He said, 'I have bought this mobile for my mother' → He said that he had bought the mobile for his mother. He said, 'I will do the shopping this week' → He said that he would do the shopping that week, when reported from a later week.

### Try another

Report from another day: They said, 'These books arrived today.'

### Suggested answer

They said that those books had arrived that day. Those and that day reflect a changed reference point rather than an automatic change required in every conversation.
